name: CLP Future Conservationist Award

funder.name: Conservation Leadership Programme (BirdLife International, Fauna & Flora, Wildlife Conservation Society)

summary: Annual project grants for teams of at least three early-career conservationists, nationals of an eligible low- or middle-income country, to combine research and conservation action on at-risk species and habitats.

geography.label: Low- and middle-income countries in Africa, Asia, the Pacific, Latin America and the Caribbean, Eastern and South-eastern Europe and the Middle East

status.quote: Concept notes must be submitted by the deadline of Friday, October 30, 2026, 23:59 GMT.

deadline.quote: Concept notes must be submitted by the deadline of Friday, October 30, 2026, 23:59 GMT.

applicant_types.quote: CLP supports teams of individuals with less than five years of paid conservation experience, who display a strong commitment to conservation and demonstrate leadership potential.

geography.quote: The project must take place in one of the eligible low- and middle-income countries in Africa, Asia, the Pacific, Latin America and the Caribbean, Eastern and South-eastern Europe and the Middle East.

access.quote: Concept notes should be submitted to clp.applications@birdlife.org.

window.quote: Each year, CLP calls for applications to support projects in biodiverse yet under resourced countries worldwide.

amount.quote: The total funding request from CLP must not exceed US$15,000 and CLP funding must cover at least 50% of the project budget.
